Welcome to **D·A·M·N (Drop Any Media Now)**, your anonymous, direct-hosting command center.

🚀 **Getting Started**

1. **Pick Your Content**: Use the **File** or **Folder** buttons on the Home tab. Visitors will see a professional file browser for folder shares. **PRO TIP**: If your folder contains an `index.html` or `index.php` file, it will serve as a **live website**!
2. **Start the Server**: Tap the big **START** button. Your device is now a live web server!

💻 **Live Terminal & Instructions**

The terminal at the bottom of the Home screen is a **real live console**. It provides real-time logs and error reports directly from the server engines. Use these shortcuts:
• **Touch Globe**: Launch the URL directly in your browser.
• **Long Press Address**: Copy any URL or log line to your clipboard.
• **Touch Dashboard Node**: Manually ping any component to check its health.

🌐 **Connection Methods**

• **Local URL**: Fastest sharing with devices on your same Wi-Fi network.
• **Public URL (NAT/UPnP)**: Attempts to open a port on your home router for direct IP access (Requires UPnP enabled on router).
• **Tor (.onion)**: Gold standard for privacy. Total anonymity, works through almost any firewall, but slower speeds.
• **Ngrok & Cloudflare**: High-speed tunnels. Cloudflare supports "Quick Tunnels" (no account needed). **Ngrok** requires an **Auth Token** for stability—get yours for free at **https://dashboard.ngrok.com/get-started/your-authtoken**.

📊 **The Dashboard**

• **Routing Chart**: Visual map of traffic entry. Tap any node in the chart to trigger a manual health-check!
• **Live Traffic**: Real-time IN and OUT speeds in KB/s.
• **Ping History**: 60-second latency graph for all connections.

📱 **Navigation & Gestures**

• **Swipe Navigation**: Smoothly switch between **Home**, **Dashboard**, and **Settings** by swiping left or right anywhere on the screen.
• **Fullscreen**: Tap the `[ ]` icon to maximize your workspace.

⚙️ **Advanced Settings**

• **Shutdown On Disconnect**: Automatically stops the server after 1 minute of inactivity.
• **Sound Alerts**: Phone beeps every 2 seconds if a connection drops.
• **Password Protection**: Lock your files behind a login screen.
